Name Irazu (Batsu-CS 1, Irazy, Irazú, Dspace)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status Reentry 2020-03-04. Was operational (Last W2RTV report 2019-05-24)
Launched 2018-04-02
NORAD ID 43468
Deployer J-SSOD (JEM Small Satellite Orbital Deployer)
Launcher Falcon 9 (CRS-14)
Deployment Deployed from ISS on 2018-05-11
Organization Costa Rican Institute of Technology (TEC)
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Nation Costa Rica
Launch brokerer JAXA
Partners GomSpace, Central American Association for Aeronautics and Space (ACAE), Delft University of Technology
Oneliner

Educational training and monitor the growth in biomass of planted trees.
Description

To complete a space project life-cycle, and to develop a platform to monitor the growth in biomass of planted trees to offset carbon emissions and to help reduce Global Warming.

Notes

"The spacecraft had already been launched to the ISS on April 2nd and therefore it was not possible to undertake coordination", IAC 2013.
